_doc: Species (docs/CONTENT.md section 9), read by scripts/crew/crew_member.gd. A crew member's `species` (set by the ship design's `crew` list) sets their max hp (hp), walk speed (speed, a factor on the 3 cells/s base), traits (merged with personal traits from data/crew.json and gear traits, see CrewMember.traits()), the art folder they are drawn with (rig: art/crew/<rig>/) and the hand weapon they carry (sidearm: an id of data/hand_weapons.json, drawn when idle in a fight). mult: factors on a rule, multiplied together with those of the member's traits (see `traits` below); heal_others scales the speed of reviving a crewmate. traits: what a trait id does. mult stats: no_air_damage (damage taken in a room without air), fire_damage (damage taken standing in a fire), repair_time (the time a repair or breach job takes). A trait with no entry here (suit) is only a label that abilities.gd checks against operator_needs. default: the species of anyone whose design names none.
